scenario: [LNLS.3.3c]: a negated pattern whose `where` references an earlier binding is anchored like a positive one. `no R x where x.amount > d.level` pins no key of `R`, so each new `D` token would scan every `R` to decide whether one blocks it. Refused. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.lnls_3_3_anchors` judging a `no` pattern; judging positive patterns only turns this vector red with compile_ok.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema D scope logical:
    id: String key
    level: Int mutable

schema R scope logical:
    id: String key
    amount: Int mutable

rule r:
    D d
    no R x where x.amount > d.level
->
    log info "x"
